name: spiritNormalHit
description: Calculates spirit (guardian spirit) damage. Has two modes: Spirit vs Spirit (direct calculation) and Spirit vs Player (scales parent's damage formulas by config coefficients).

config_used.configSpirit_level: Looked up by (spirit_id, spirit_level) from attacker.data.spiritInfo; provides att_dam coefficient array

Spirit vs Player (defender is not Spirit.description: Uses configSpirit_level to get scaling coefficients, then computes parent player's damage from four formulas and scales each by a coefficient

sub_steps.description: Look up att_dam config array from configSpirit_level using spirit_id and spirit_level
sub_steps.formula: config = configSpirit_level.getDataByKeys('spirit_id', spiritInfo[0], 'spirit_level', spiritInfo[1]); coefficients = config.att_dam (array of [key, value] pairs)

sub_steps.description: Build coefficient map from att_dam array
sub_steps.formula: A = { key: value for each [key, value] in config.att_dam }

sub_steps.description: Calculate each damage component using parent (player) as attacker, with crit_flag=1 (no crit) and usePierceResist=false

simplified_formula.spirit_vs_player: round(normalDoubleHurt(parent, def, 1, false)*A[1]/10000 + normalCounterHurt(parent, def, 1, false)*A[2]/10000 + normalHurt(parent, def, 1, false)*A[3]/10000 + SkillHurt(parent, def, 1, false)*A[4]/10000)
